body.message:
Hello Mr. Salim,

Please accept our sincere apologies for the delay. We will update you tomorrow after 10:00 AM regarding your last day and check-out date.

Regarding the deposit, once you have completed the check-out, upside team will carry out the inspection. After it is finalized, we will proceed with the refund either to the same card used for the payment or, if you prefer, you may share your bank details and our team will assist you accordingly.

Kindly note that the deposit refund process may take up to 14 working days after the check-out date.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.
